quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on Dylan Harper's competitiveness in video games
quotes.quote: He's competitive in every game. So he'll be like, let's play this new game, right? Like we played WWE. He'd be like, I don't know how to play, I don't know none of the buttons, nothing. We go in the game, he knows every move, he knows what button to click at the right time, he knows everything.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 彼は競技的で、どのゲームでもそう。新しいゲームをする時もね。WWEをした時、彼は操作を全く知らないと言ったのに、いざ始めてみたら操作は完璧だったよ
quotes.social_post: Stephon Castle calls out Dylan Harper for being a secret pro at video games despite claiming he does not know how to play.
